verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents ingesting traces, logs, and metrics through OpenTelemetry/OTLP into one platform. Traces and logs are stored as structured events, indexed on every field and queryable without a schema, which implies shared context between them. Explicit pivoting between metrics and traces/logs is not documented, and community reports describe teams still splitting logs and metrics across other tools. That is not a concrete failure of the capability. missing for 10: documented cross-signal pivot workflow (metrics↔traces↔logs with shared context), independent hands-on corroboration of unified correlation.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can collect metrics, logs, and traces in one platform and pivot between them with shared context

citations.quote: send traces, logs, and metrics to Honeycomb
traces and logs are stored as structured events... indexed automatically on every field at ingest, and queryable without a predefined schema.
